# Northwind Instruments — Annual Report 2024

Page 1

## Summary

Northwind Instruments reported revenue of 45.2 million dollars in fiscal 2024,
up from 38.7 million in 2023. Gross margin improved to 41 percent from 37
percent. Operating income was 6.9 million dollars against 4.1 million the year
before.

The board declared a dividend of 0.32 dollars per share, payable 14 March 2025.

## Operations

The Sheffield plant produced 12,400 units in 2024. Unplanned downtime totalled
3 days in the second quarter, caused by a coolant pump failure that has since
been replaced under warranty. Headcount at Sheffield was 214 at year end.

The Leipzig plant produced 9,850 units with no unplanned downtime. Headcount was
168, unchanged year on year. Leipzig absorbed the calibration work previously
subcontracted to a third party, which accounts for most of the margin gain.

## Risk factors

Currency exposure remains the principal risk. A 10 percent adverse move in
EUR/USD would shift operating income by approximately 2.1 million dollars.
The company does not currently hedge beyond twelve months.

Supply concentration is the secondary risk. Two vendors account for 61 percent
of input cost by value. A qualification programme for a third vendor began in
November 2024 and is expected to conclude in the second half of 2025.

Regulatory exposure is limited. The 2023 instrumentation directive does not
apply to the company's product classes.

## Outlook

Management expects revenue between 49 and 52 million dollars in 2025, assuming
no material change in EUR/USD. Capital expenditure is budgeted at 6.4 million
dollars, of which 4.0 million is committed to the Leipzig calibration line.
